newsitem.title: USA: US average retail beef prices lower in March -NCBA.
newsitem.headline: US average retail beef prices lower in March -NCBA.

text.p: Average retail beef prices decreased in March from February and consumers can expect further bargains through the upcoming grilling season, the National Cattlemen's Beef Association said.

NCBA said that based on U.S. Agriculture Department data, the national average price of all fresh retail beef cuts in March was $2.53 a lb, versus $2.54 in February and $2.52 in March 1996. The price is based on 15 individual cuts and includes all grades of beef (choice, select and ungraded).
The USDA all choice retail beef price average was $2.76 a lb in March, against $2.79 in February and $2.76 a year ago.
The average price of beef cuts featured in newspaper advertisements in March was $2.44 a lb, against $2.50 in February and $2.43 a year earlier, the NCBA said.
The featuring data is derived from NCBA/CattleFax data.
The NCBA said analysts predicted retail prices will remain low.

"Memorial Day, the biggest beef consumption day of the year, signals the beginning of the summer grilling season and consumers will benefit from the lower prices on several popular cuts of beef," the release said.

Beginning in January 1997, the NCBA changed its monthly analysis to include 15 cuts of beef from six previously. For its featuring survey, it added special low advertised beef prices, prices for all grades of beef, and prices gathered throughout the month rather than once a month.
The featuring survey is divided into five geographic areas and includes all states except Alaska and Hawaii, compared to the previous 19-city monthly survey.

The averages of the five regions for the 15 cuts in March were: ground chuck $1.82 per lb, regular ground beef $1.36, lean ground beef $2.03; select boneless chuck roast $2.23; choice boneless chuck roast $2.45, choice boneless round roast $2.89, select round roast $2.69, choice rib roast $5.14, choice T-bone steak $5.64, choice rib-eye steak $5.75, choice boneless round steak $3.15, select round steak $2.98, select sirloin steak $3.59, choice boneless sirloin steak $4.13, and boneless beef for stew $2.47.
